title: Realize all 23 owned rises under retained operator and ownership contracts (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope
Realize all 23 owned rises of #6902 using exact phase-bearing monomial adapters and one completed positive child on the same current field. The retained contracts allow arbitrary contents, prior reads and intervening scalar contacts.

Rank mass 56 is already paid; 2,019 adapter records fit the existing 23,000 allowance. The full 38,334-event lifetime scan retains peak 30 and 53 dirty clears. This resolves the additional A6 direction/content implication under retained contracts, without proving those contracts. No new κ.

## Sources and verification
Base: 7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a.
Head: 11aa5341e740a8d9dd14ab54437a45840686e991.
Source #6902: e4d42607f24d7a049b0fca329dc4c34882405c25; exact pins in SOURCES.json/RETAINED.json.

Run:
`python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/owned-ascent-contract`

Fresh Python 3.12.14 replay passed all four registered normal/optimized checks: 11,776 basis cases, 6,029,312 exact entries, complete lifetimes and phase/alias/erasure controls. Expected: PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE. Committed bytes/modes and whitespace pass. Later #6902 changes leave executable inputs unchanged.

## Limits and credit
Physical erasure, complete allocation/control, native/caller admission, BIT and all five assumptions remain. Fresh finite-template constants and distinct occurrence banks are required. Frontier unchanged.

@CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; distinct algorithms share their original author. Credit DreamingOfClouds, #5241/#4416, Matarener (#5445), Ali Romman (#5377), Chris R/Clear1nsight, #2479 and retained authors. Apache-2.0.
